President Trump proposed a $5,000 voter dividend if Republicans retain Congress, while Democratic-aligned groups utilize paid relational organizing programs.

Turning elections into direct financial transactions degrades democratic discourse into rival bribery operations.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing substantive democratic representation (Q4 Why) with transactional bribery (Q1 Who), reducing citizens to purchased commodities.

Social Physics Analysis:
Political actors execute a Smart Selfish maneuver. They run the economy down, manufacture economic anxiety, and offer cash dividends as a pretext to secure power without delivering structural reforms.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between democratic ideals and transactional vote-buying, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. F_pos < F_neg drives ψ negative.

The Unavoidable Truth: Financial incentives increasingly replace substantive policy debates in modern campaigns.

The Unavoidable Lie: Cash dividends represent genuine economic relief rather than electoral bribes.
